document.lead: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

text: From academic journals to airline cockpits, English now serves as the common language of global communication. In my view, the benefits of a shared international language clearly outweigh the drawbacks, provided that countries continue to protect and develop their own languages alongside it.

The greatest advantage is that a common language makes cooperation far easier. Scientists from different countries can read each other’s research without waiting for translations, and businesses can negotiate directly with partners across the world. International organisations, from the United Nations to global sports federations, work more efficiently when their members share a working language. For individuals, English opens doors to international education and employment; a student in Shymkent can now attend online lectures from leading foreign universities without leaving home. In this sense, a global language can actually reduce inequality between countries rather than increase it.

Nevertheless, the dominance of English has real costs. Native speakers enjoy a clear advantage in academic publishing and international negotiations, while others must invest years of study to compete on equal terms. More seriously, when English becomes the language of success, young people may neglect their mother tongue, and smaller languages risk losing speakers. In Kazakhstan, where Kazakh, Russian and English already compete for attention, this is a genuine concern.

In conclusion, a shared global language brings enormous practical benefits to science, business and education, and these outweigh its disadvantages. However, the risks to other languages are serious enough that governments should actively support national languages, so that English becomes an additional tool rather than a replacement. Learning a global language and valuing one’s own are not contradictory goals.

note.en: Gives the answer in the introduction.
note.ru: Вводит ответ на вопрос уже во введении.

note.en: The condition under which the benefits win.
The topic sentence of the advantages paragraph.

note.ru: Переход от организаций к отдельным людям.

note.en: Compares native speakers with everyone else.
note.kk: Ана тілінде сөйлейтіндер мен басқалардың жағдайын салыстырады.

note.en: Introduces a more serious drawback — in rising order.
note.kk: Күштірек кемшілікті енгізеді — күшейе түсу ретімен.
note.ru: Вводит более серьёзный минус — по нарастающей.

strengths.en: The writer answers the “outweigh” question in the first paragraph and repeats it in the conclusion.
strengths.kk: «outweigh» сұрағына автор бірінші абзацта жауап беріп, қорытындыда қайталайды.
strengths.ru: На «outweigh» автор отвечает в первом абзаце и повторяет ответ в выводе.
strengths.example: the benefits of a shared international language clearly outweigh the drawbacks

strengths.en: The writer turns the critics’ argument around: a common language may reduce inequality.
strengths.kk: Автор қарсыластардың дәлелін керісінше бұрады: ортақ тіл теңсіздікті азайтуы мүмкін.
strengths.ru: Автор переворачивает довод противников: общий язык может уменьшать неравенство.
strengths.example: a global language can actually reduce inequality between countries

strengths.en: Three languages in Kazakhstan make an abstract risk concrete and familiar.
strengths.kk: Қазақстандағы үш тіл абстрактілі қауіпті түсінікті әрі жақын етеді.
strengths.ru: Три языка в Казахстане делают абстрактную угрозу понятной и близкой.
strengths.example: where Kazakh, Russian and English already compete for attention

strengths.en: “More seriously” signals that the second drawback matters more — well-planned Coherence.
strengths.kk: «More seriously» екінші кемшіліктің біріншісінен маңыздырақ екенін көрсетеді — бұл ойластырылған Coherence.
strengths.ru: «More seriously» показывает, что второй минус важнее первого, — это продуманная Coherence.
strengths.example: More seriously, when English becomes the language of success

note.en: Introduction: a vivid image (from journals to cockpits) and a direct answer to the “outweigh” question, with a condition.
note.kk: Кіріспе: жарқын көрініс (журналдардан ұшқыштар кабинасына дейін) және «outweigh» сұрағына шарты бар тура жауап.
note.ru: Введение: яркая картинка (от журналов до кабин пилотов) и прямой ответ на вопрос «outweigh» с условием.

note.en: Advantages: science, business and personal opportunity with an example from Shymkent, plus an unexpected point — inequality may fall.
note.kk: Артықшылықтар: ғылым, бизнес, Шымкенттен мысалы бар жеке мүмкіндіктер және күтпеген қорытынды — теңсіздік азаюы мүмкін.
note.ru: Плюсы: наука, бизнес, личные возможности с примером из Шымкента и неожиданный вывод — неравенство может уменьшиться.

note.en: Disadvantages: the native-speaker advantage and the threat to other languages — both points from the task, with Kazakhstan as an example.
note.kk: Кемшіліктер: ана тілінде сөйлейтіндердің артықшылығы және ана тілдерге қауіп — тапсырмадағы екі нұсқа да, Қазақстан мысалымен.
note.ru: Минусы: преимущество носителей и угроза родным языкам — обе версии из задания, с примером Казахстана.

note.en: Conclusion: the position and a practical condition — English as an addition, not a replacement.
note.kk: Қорытынды: ұстаным және іске асатын шарт — ағылшын тілі алмастырушы емес, қосымша құрал.
note.ru: Вывод: позиция и практичное условие — английский как дополнение, а не замена.

document.title: English as a global language
document.question:
English has become the main language of international business, science and the internet. Some welcome this as a way of bringing people together, while others fear that it gives native speakers an unfair advantage and threatens other languages.

Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
